description: Non-gating cases modeled on issues found by the managed connector after a prior review pass.

cases.title: Retired component survives an upgrade path
cases.scenario: Upgrade an existing installation that still records the retired component.

cases.title: Unchanged consumer still relies on the old contract
cases.scenario: Exercise an unchanged caller after the producer changes its state or return contract.

cases.title: Platform-specific build excludes the new implementation
cases.scenario: Compile or test the affected package on a non-Unix target.

cases.title: Cancellation can strand a waiter or lock
cases.scenario: Cancel while one worker owns the lock and another is waiting.

cases.title: Permission behavior changes when tests run as root
cases.scenario: Run the operation under root and an unprivileged account.

cases.title: One runtime overlay misses the shared behavior change
cases.scenario: Invoke equivalent workflows from both supported runtime overlays.
